name: Music
subtitle: Music streaming and playback
description: Tweaked and alternative music clients: lossless Spotify playback, ad-free YouTube Music and a library importer that skips the desktop sync entirely.

apps.name: ByeTunes
apps.subtitle: Add music to the iOS library without a computer
apps.localizedDescription: ByeTunes writes MP3, M4A, FLAC and WAV files straight into the iOS media library by talking to the media database directly, so adding a song no longer needs a cable and a desktop sync session. You can create and manage playlists in the app, and import metadata is fetched from iTunes or Deezer. The ringtone injector is disabled upstream for now, so treat ringtones as not working yet. Open source under the MIT license, with the iOS build published from the project's own GitHub releases.
apps.versionDescription:
ByeTunes 2.5 | ByeTunes

Hi guys, here's the 2.5 update for ByeTunes. This one adds full Deezer support and real parallel downloads for way faster queues, plus a brand new Smart Playlists feature with custom cover art. On top of that, a bunch of reliability fixes across downloads, backups, and repair tools — including a crash fix for the download queue.

**Quick recommendation:** for the best speed and match accuracy while searching, set Deezer as your Search Provider. And to keep full Apple Music compatibility (animated artwork, richer info), keep Apple Music as your Metadata Source.

**Deezer — full provider support**

- Deezer is now a full first-class search source alongside Apple Music/iTunes, with its own tab ("Search or paste a Deezer link")
- Paste a Deezer track/album/artist/playlist link and it resolves directly — same one-tap flow Apple Music/Spotify links already had
- Deezer artist pages now show real top tracks + full discography (up to 100 each), not just a flat track list
- Deezer search results paginate ("load more"), merged into the same song/album results as other providers
- "Find on Deezer" added alongside "Find on Spotify" as an in-app browser shortcut for failed downloads

**Download Engine — real concurrency & speed**

- Downloads used to run one at a time through a single sequential task; now use a real worker-pool so multiple tracks download in parallel
- Concurrency is format-aware: 3 simultaneous downloads for lossy formats, capped to 2 for lossless (FLAC/ALAC), since lossless generation is much more expensive on the backend
- Added a start-pacer that spaces out when new downloads begin (wider gap for lossless) on top of the concurrency cap — bursts of simultaneous requests were triggering backend 429/500 errors even within the concurrency limit
- Fixed the download engine getting silently recreated from scratch whenever the Download tab's view was torn down (older iOS layout) — was orphaning in-flight downloads and losing queue state; now backed by a shared instance that survives it
- Aggregate download speed now tracked and shown live across all active downloads

**Background Downloads**

- Fixed isAppActive defaulting to true on a silent background relaunch, which routed transfers through the short-lived foreground path instead of the durable background session (caused FLAC→MP3 downgrades and stalls)
- Fixed the candidate fallback loop not checking cancellation, which let a cancelled foreground download silently complete via the MP3 fallback instead of aborting
- Completed-but-unclaimed background download results now persist to disk so a killed/relaunched app recovers them instead of re-downloading
- Finished tracks now persist their own .done state so a relaunch mid-queue doesn't drop them from Queue Details
- Added a genuine background-processing task (registered at launch) so metadata fetching can run even when the app isn't open, instead of only opportunistically while active
- Each backend candidate now uses its own requested format for its file-extension fallback instead of a hardcoded "flac" default
- Plain-language failure messages in the download queue instead of raw HTTP/backend error bodies
- Fixed link.deezer.com short links not resolving
- Fixed a crash: removing a failed download could resurrect it (and crash on the second removal) because a stray background-session completion callback fired after removal and wrote the state back. Removal now properly cancels the underlying background task too.

**Smart Playlists**

- Create playlists by rule: Genre, Artist, Decade, Format, or Explicit Rating
- Multi-select across all rule types with combined naming (e.g. "Rock, Pop" or "1990s, 2000s")
- Live match counts, search within Genre/Artist lists, lossless-format badges
- Artist grouping splits collab credits ("A & B") into separate artists, matching the on-device Artists tab
- "Refresh Smart Playlist" — remembers its rule and can re-sync to catch newly matching songs

**Playlists**

- New naming screen matches Apple Music: photo picker, large title field, X/checkmark controls — used for manual and smart playlist creation alike
- Custom playlist cover photos: pick a photo, it's auto-cropped to a square and uploaded using the same on-device artwork system Apple Music itself uses; persists across relaunch
- In-playlist rename
- Playlist restore now lists which specific tracks failed to match instead of just a count

**On-Device Library**

- Select/Select All controls pinned so they stay visible while scrolling
- Select/Select All/Add to Playlist/Add to Album/Export restricted to the Songs tab; Playlists tab gets Select/Select All/Export/Delete
- Removed redundant header title/count and Export Folder picker from non-Songs tabs
- Audio Quality Analysis (new): tapping a song shows a verdict flagging mislabeled files (e.g. an MP3 renamed .flac), suspiciously over-compressed "lossless" files, and low-bitrate lossy files
- On-device album metadata editing
- In-place device audio file replacement
- Content Rating redesigned from a cramped segmented control to a compact menu row, with a new "No Rating" option
- Fixed the explicit/clean rating editor: a binary toggle could only ever write explicit/none, silently flipping "clean" tracks to explicit

**Reliability Fixes**

- Injection failures no longer silently drop songs from the queue — unconfirmed songs are put back
- Repair operations (artwork fix, database doctor, alphabetical order) use per-operation cancellation tokens instead of one shared flag, so cancelling one can no longer kill an unrelated one
- Background metadata fetch no longer double-imports a song if the process is killed mid-drain
- Artwork upload failures during metadata edits are now reported instead of silently swallowed
- A failed database integrity check now aborts the library merge instead of writing on top of a known-corrupt database
- Fixed the large-batch injection safeguard checking the wrong count
- Fixed byetunes://download deep links opening the wrong tab on iOS 16–18
- Fixed a Live Activity race that could resurrect it right after ending; orphaned Live Activities from a killed session now clean up on cold launch
- Removed dead Tidal/Qobuz code and a broken last-resort Spotify mapping fallback

**Backup & Restore**

- Merged Light/Full Backup toggle and "Export Full Library" into two direct-action rows; Full Backup always bundles per-playlist files

**Settings**

- Store Region picker upgraded from a simple inline row to a full searchable, alphabetically-grouped screen with flags
- About/Credits moved to its own section, separate from actionable controls
- Added "Keep Local Metadata" to skip the fetch pipeline for imported local files

apps.name: Cosmos Music Player
apps.subtitle: Music player
apps.localizedDescription: Cosmos Music Player is a premium music player for iOS built on iCloud Drive and local storage. It gives you a clean, modern player for the music you keep on your device and in iCloud.
apps.versionDescription:
Cosmos Music Player 1.2.5 | Cosmos-Music-Player

- Search is now available across songs, favorites, artists, albums, and playlists.
- Lyrics have been redesigned with smoother synchronization, tap-to-seek, instrumental breaks, offline caching, and alternate versions.
- Added broader support for Opus, Ogg, FLAC, AAC/M4A, DSF, and DFF files.
- Improved playback stability, gapless transitions, seeking, Bluetooth, CarPlay, and audio interruption handling.
- Added appearance options: System, Light, and Dark.
- Added controls for automatic library scan frequency and artist organization.
- Added a Create Playlist button when no playlists exist.
- Improved artwork loading for iCloud and externally imported music.
- Improved Siri, widgets, CarPlay, and Share extension reliability.
- Fixed library issues involving moved, renamed, restored, or temporarily unavailable files.
- Added and improved translations across all supported languages.
- Includes numerous performance improvements and bug fixes.

apps.name: MaxMusic
apps.subtitle: YTMusicUltimate with extra tweaks
apps.localizedDescription: MaxMusic (formerly YTMUltimate+) is Mark02-2012's fork of Dayanch96's YTMusicUltimate for the YouTube Music app on iOS. It keeps everything YTMusicUltimate provides — no ads, background playback, download manager, audio quality selection — and adds Return YouTube Music Dislike, YouMusicPiP, YTMABConfig and VolumeBoostYT, plus fixed in-app downloads on newer YouTube Music versions. Settings live inside YouTube Music under Settings.

apps.name: SpotiFLAC Mobile
apps.subtitle: FLAC Downloader for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: SpotiFLAC Mobile is an open-source Spotify track and playlist metadata downloader and FLAC converter for iOS and Android. Search and download high-quality FLAC and MP3 audio with complete ID3 metadata, embedded album artwork, and synchronized lyrics directly on your device.
apps.versionDescription:
SpotiFLAC 5.0.0 | SpotiFLAC-v5.0.0-ios-unsigned

### New Features

- **onboarding**: Add theme-aware 5.0 upgrade introduction
- **library**: Add Mornye browsing and contextual compact navigation
- **home**: Add large featured cards for extension feeds
- **mornye**: Separate Search into a circular navigation button
- **profile**: Add local profiles with backup and restore
- **player**: Add beat-matched AutoMix and refine Mornye navigation
- **artists**: Add branded headers and incremental release loading
- **mornye**: Cache motion covers and refine player and search
- **ui**: Add Mornye glass theme and adaptive music player
- Add opt-in Discord Rich Presence on Android
- **metadata**: Display saved ReplayGain values and refresh after analysis
- **backend**: Migrate production backend to Rust
- **backup**: Allow selecting categories and settings-only backups

### Bug Fixes

- **ci**: Audit stripped iOS archives and configure FFmpeg tests
- Retry verification browser launch and failed searches
- Sync lyric romanization and clear stale selection menus
- **mornye**: Show track summary and update welcome branding
- **metadata**: Remove nested barcode card background
- **mornye**: Preserve icon meaning and use consistent settings accents
- **settings**: Simplify player copy and add glass library info card
- **ui**: Resolve album titles and show Home explicit badges
- **ui**: Align local lyrics and refine Mornye selection
- **player**: Preserve offline motion artwork and smooth cover changes
- **ios**: Keep release feed bundle identity in sync
- **android**: Validate native metadata editor results
- Preserve source artist credits when downloading
- **library**: Reset checkpoints and artwork on forced full scans
- **metadata**: Read tags and covers from MP4 files named opus
- **library**: Preserve cached covers across directory aliases
- **download**: Log provider failures before fallback
- **extensions**: Restore URL globals for provider link resolution
- **download**: Preserve filenames after automatic SAF conversion
- **backup**: Allow selecting SFLB archives for restore

### Performance

- **rust**: Stream discarded FLAC artwork during replacement
- **extensions**: Avoid copying unwrapped Base64 input
- **bridge**: Reduce metadata copies and decode large JSON off the UI isolate
- **analysis**: Reuse sorted spectral percentile windows
- **audio**: Share the Opus artwork metadata buffer
- **search**: Release derived caches when track results change
- **library**: Dispose unused playback row subscriptions
- **metadata**: Move normalized Rust values into response envelopes
- **rust**: Reduce peak allocations when resizing cover artwork
- **mornye**: Reuse exact luminance contributions for contrast sampling
- **mornye**: Release outgoing artwork decoders when replaced
- **player**: Scope position and contrast rebuilds to controls
- **extensions**: Collect unreachable JavaScript cycles after idle bursts
- **images**: Decode local covers to their fitted display size
- **extensions**: Share retained source text across manager and VMs
- **extensions**: Reuse owned UTF-8 buffers at text boundaries
- **metadata**: Preserve typed values across the Rust extension bridge
- **extensions**: Validate JSON without allocating argument trees
- **cue**: Parse SAF previews without copying audio
- **android**: Batch SAF library recovery metadata queries
- **library**: Batch album deletion and refresh once
- **android**: Batch SAF lookups during download publication
- **downloads**: Log finalization stage durations
- **audio**: Validate FLAC remuxes before encoder fallback
- **downloads**: Reuse lyrics supplied by the backend
- **downloads**: Reuse HTTP connections between tracks
- **lyrics**: Stream MP3 audio when updating ID3 lyrics
- **analysis**: Serialize and cancel owned FFmpeg sessions
- **backup**: Move archive processing off the UI isolate
- **player**: Commit seek gestures once after scrubbing
- **ui**: Pause motion headers when collapsed
- **theme**: Bound cover palette decoding and coalesce requests
- **rust**: Skip audio rewrites for identical FLAC metadata

### Refactoring

- **ui**: Unify theme styling and enlarge profile button

### Styling

- Remove trailing whitespace

### Dependencies

- **deps**: Update Flutter and iOS plugin dependencies

### Chores

- **rust**: Update crypto, network and UniFFI dependencies
- **android**: Update native dependencies and build tooling
- **analyzer**: Exclude archived internal sources
- **release**: Set app version to 5.0.0+152
- Update AltStore source to v4.9.6 by [@github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot])




**Full Changelog**: [v4.9.6...v5.0.0](https://github.com/spotiflacapp/SpotiFLAC-Mobile/compare/v4.9.6...v5.0.0)

---

### Downloads

#### Android
- **arm64**: `SpotiFLAC-v5.0.0-arm64.apk` (recommended for modern devices)
- **arm32**: `SpotiFLAC-v5.0.0-arm32.apk` (older devices)

#### iOS
- **iOS**: `SpotiFLAC-v5.0.0-ios-unsigned.ipa` (sideload required)

### Installation
**Android**: Enable "Install from unknown sources" and install the APK
**iOS**: Use AltStore, Sideloadly, or similar tools to sideload the IPA
